rationale: Attempt uses the true background and directional marker context. The rule rotates each 6 around its aligned 1 while preserving distance; no available key records that distance or computes the destination.

Pixel count offers a demonstration-specific recolouring attempt and separates the small erased objects from the large objects. Generalisation requires the separate blue symbol's shape to determine the large object's colour; object properties cannot consult another object's shape.

Eight-neighbour occupancy attempts to recognise straight corridor interiors and corners. Filling depends on corridor connectivity and where the 9 interrupts traversal; identical local neighbourhoods occur in filled and unfilled sections.

Enables every nonzero source colour, including the omitted 8. Source-coloured cardinal rays reproduce the crosses, but this template cannot assign colour 2 specifically where differently coloured rays intersect.

Full local patterns attempt to distinguish square regions from thin extensions. In the first demonstration, pixels (1,2) and (1,3), indexed from zero, have identical 3x3 patterns but require 8 and 2 respectively. The other keys also cannot distinguish the required structural partition.

Attempts richer local context for filling missing object pixels. The rule fills each component's bounding rectangle, including cells beyond its visible directional neighbours; no key supplies component membership or bounding-box bounds.

Union with colour 2 attempts to recover occupied output positions, including left-only changes. The required output preserves matching colours and distinguishes right-only colour 1 from left-only colour 2; one Boolean operation and one output colour cannot express this.

Lower keep prioritises demonstrated erasure of the original red object while preserving colour 8. Translation requires some input-zero pixels to become 2 while others remain 0; this template assigns every pixel of a given input colour the same output.
Attempts eight-connected enclosure detection. The enclosed background requires a spatial pattern containing both 4 and 2; the template can only fill enclosed cells with one learned colour.

Full 3x3 context attempts to improve classification around barriers. Zero regions must become 2 when connected to the border and 5 otherwise; connectivity can differ despite identical local, row-set, column-set, parity, border, or directional-colour keys.
